entities.summary: Brett Ritchie is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for the Sheffield Steelers of the Elite Ice Hockey League (EIHL). He has formerly played in the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Dallas Stars, 44th overall, in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
